title: S2.1 external lease backend for same-key failover

context.goal: Убрать process-local ограничение S2 и ввести внешний lease backend для two-process same-key HA без split-brain.
context.motivation: S2 final review = PARTIAL: для независимых процессов с тем же validator key нужен внешний координатор аренды.

brief: Design an external lease backend that closes the S2 process-local split-brain gap for same-key multi-process failover. Done for this slice when the design report, backend recommendation, atomic operation contract, failure semantics, migration path, and two-process acceptance plan are documented.

delegations.prompt_summary: Design gate for S2.1 external lease backend; no product Rust edits. Scope: file-lock vs lightweight KV recommendation, lease schema, CAS operations, failure/security semantics, migration from process-local S2, and two-process same-key acceptance plan.

Implement S2.1 external LeaseBackend MVP: file-lock JSON backend with CAS acquire/renew/release/takeover, fail-closed single_sealer gate integration, status/log observability, backend/unit tests and two-node takeover simulation, plus runbook/review doc updates.
S2.1 lease: targeted cargo test (filter lease), cargo check -p pwmd, report + ticket artifacts; commit hash validation note.
Final gate S2.1 external lease: CAS/fail-closed/split-brain/obs/tests; deliver final review md + ticket final_verdict.

backend_recommendation.mvp_choice: file-lock JSON lease backend on local/shared volume
backend_recommendation.rationale: Matches current local/Docker testnet workflow, closes same-host/shared-volume multi-process split-brain without adding etcd/Consul operational dependency, and can be hidden behind a LeaseBackend trait for a later KV backend.
backend_recommendation.boundary: Not a full multi-host HA coordinator unless the shared volume provides reliable POSIX-like locking; independent multi-host testnet should move to a lightweight KV backend with server-side CAS/revision and TTL.

acceptance_plan: Unit-test file backend acquire, renew, release, conditional takeover, corrupt record, IO failure, and concurrent same-record winner uniqueness.
Run two separate pwmd processes with same validator key, same single_sealer profile, shared seal_lease_dir, distinct data dirs/ports; assert exactly one local sealer.
Kill the active process without graceful release; assert standby takes over only after expiry + takeover timeout and increments term/fence.
Restart the old active process; assert stale owner cannot renew/release over the newer owner and does not produce blocks.
Induce backend unavailable/permission errors; assert both active and standby fail closed instead of sealing on cached ownership.
